subject: ISO / FedRAMP intake — scope & evidence triage
messages:
From: Lisa Morgan <l.morgan@orionfin.com>

Cc: audit@fed-audit.com
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Initial intake — ISO 27001 + FedRAMP questionnaire

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting an internal audit and need to confirm Redwood's scope and timing for two tracks: ISO 27001 certification and a FedRAMP readiness assessment tied to our cloud-hosted workloads. Attached is our initial SIG/CAIQ matrix (Orion_SIG-CAIQ.xlsx) and a brief spreadsheet with the controls we absolutely need evidence for in the next 4 weeks.

Top asks:
- Confirm whether Redwood considers customer data in "shared control" (i.e., is our production network in scope for FedRAMP) or whether you propose isolation via Dedicated/Private deployment.
- Provide a short list of evidence artifacts we can expect within 7 business days (audit logs, key rotation proof, SOC 2 type II report, encryption configuration).
- Point to a single intake POC and a location for evidence uploads.

We'd like to run a 30–45 minute intake call next week to triage controls and assign owners. Are you available Tuesday or Wednesday morning ET?

Regards,
Lisa Morgan
Head of Vendor Risk — Orion Financial

Attachments: Orion_SIG-CAIQ.xlsx

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com

Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Initial intake — ISO 27001 + FedRAMP questionnaire

Hi Lisa — thanks for the packet and the timeline. Quick responses below and a proposed plan: 

Short answers: 
- Scope: For hosted customers on the Redwood Hosted API, we operate a shared-control model. For FedRAMP-bound workloads we recommend Dedicated or Private (VPC) deployments so Orion's boundary aligns with your FedRAMP scoping requirements.
- Evidence: We can produce the following within 7 business days for an initial intake: SOC 2 Type II summary, access control policy excerpts, KMS rotation records (redacted), audit-log retention policy, and a list of control owners. Full artifacts (raw logs) will require an evidence transfer link / DPA agreement.
- Intake POC & upload: I'll be primary POC. Please use the Drive folder link below for initial uploads; we can provision a secure SFTP if preferred.

Proposed next steps (intake 1):
1) 30-min triage call — Tue Apr 15 10:00 AM ET or Wed Apr 16 10:00 AM ET. Confirm what works.
2) Redwood to deliver an "evidence hit list" within 48 hours after the call.
3) Assign control owners and sample windows for the 90-day lookback.

Cc'ing Mina, who will coordinate evidence owners, and Kimberly for FedRAMP scoping specifics. Aditya will help with any procurement/redline questions if we need to expedite contractual terms for evidence transfer.

Jordan Blake
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF_shared-evidence

Jordan — I pulled together an initial evidence matrix (attached: evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx) and a proposed owner map. Notes: 

- Evidence buckets we can surface quickly (<=7 business days): SOC 2 binder extract (controls 1.0–4.0), IAM user/service-account list + MFAs, KMS key metadata (rotation timestamps), and sample audit log snippets (redacted).

Jordan / Mina — a couple of practical clarifications for the intake so the call is focused: 

1) Boundary: If Orion intends to claim FedRAMP on your SOW for specific workloads, we need a written scoping decision before the assessment. Practically, that means either a) designate Dedicated/Private for those workloads, or b) accept that the control set will include Redwood's shared infrastructure (this expands auditor requests).

2) Evidence QA: We'll surface "artifact types" rather than full raw exports during the first pass. For example, provide a KMS key metadata CSV (timestamps + key IDs) and a sanitized sample of audit logs rather than a full bucket. If Orion needs raw logs for their auditor, we'll agree on a transfer method and an NDA addendum.

3) Controls flagged for early triage: change control, vulnerability management cadence, and key management. Prepare brief owners notes for each (one paragraph) so the auditor gets context.

I'll join the Wed 16th session unless Jordan confirms Tuesday.

Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
